facts.fact: The DGSN's 2023 annual review says GESTARR was connected in 2023 to a new computer system for managing the criminal and misdemeanour cases handled by the police arrondissements, which also prepares and analyses statistics.
facts.system: Système informatique de gestion des affaires pénales et des délits

facts.fact: The DGSN's 2023 review says the case-management system is in experimental use in 350 police posts within the police prefectures of Kénitra, Tangier, Meknès, Marrakech and Settat and the provincial sûreté of Safi; the same review counts 454 police arrondissements nationally, and says 2024 is to see its complete generalisation to all arrondissements.
facts.system: Système informatique de gestion des affaires pénales et des délits

facts.fact: The DGSN's 2023 review says that in 2023 the generalisation of GESTARR was completed and the new criminal-case management system was linked to it and put on trial in 350 police posts.
facts.system: Système informatique de gestion des affaires pénales et des délits

facts.fact: The DGSN's 2023 review says the DGSN's own technical services developed the applications concerned, GESTARR and the case-management system linked to it.
